intent: 4BR / 3 bath SPLIT WINGS canonical smoke test, no carport — the catalog's FIRST 4-bedroom topology. 18x13 lot gives a 14x8 envelope; the solve lands 112.0 m² of floor, inside the 100-150 m² 4BR/3-bath band. Twin symmetric bedroom wings flank a central public core: master + ensuite_m + common_w + hall_w + br_guest1 west, br2 + ensuite2 + common_e + hall_e + br_guest2 east, great_room (entry, front) + kitchen (rear) between them. Every bedroom reaches a bath inside its own wing, and both shared-bath doors open onto their wing's hall lobby rather than onto the LDK — two corrections made against the source precedent (pep_SHD-2015021). This brief also pins the anchor relaxation: the topology was INFEASIBLE at every lot size as authored because left_anchored + right_anchored + front_to_rear_stacks were declared together (the recurring over-constrained-anchors trap); all three are now null and rear_anchored alone does the shaping. Feasible 18x13 / 17x12 / 16x12; 15x11 solves but at 65.3 m² is far below band, so 18x13 is the published minimum.
must_haves: twin symmetric bedroom wings with their own hall lobby each
every bedroom's bath inside its own wing
bath doors onto a hall lobby, never onto the open LDK
